Templates.Title: From the Ashes
Templates.Text:
Commander,

They said {PlayerFaction} was finished. They were wrong.

After {MissionsWon} of {TotalMissions} engagements, we stand. {EnemyFaction} retreats.

We did not just survive. We prevailed.

Templates.Title: A Costly Retreat
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} fought to the last. We won {MissionsWon} of {TotalMissions} engagements.

It was not enough. {EnemyFaction} holds the field.

We withdraw. For now.

Templates.Title: A New Power
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} is no longer an upstart. After {MissionsWon} of {TotalMissions} engagements, the galaxy takes notice.

{EnemyFaction} knows our name. So does everyone else.

The stars have a new power.

Templates.Title: Ambition Checked
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} reached too far. {MissionsWon} wins from {TotalMissions} was not enough.

{EnemyFaction} held firm. Our ascent is delayed.

We are not done. But we are not yet what we hoped to be.

Templates.Title: Total Dominion
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{MissionsWon} of {TotalMissions} engagements. {EnemyFaction} broken. The stars bow.

{PlayerFaction} does not negotiate. It does not retreat.

It conquers.

Templates.Title: Conquest Denied
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} marched on the stars. We won {MissionsWon} of {TotalMissions} engagements.

{EnemyFaction} refused to fall. Our conquest is incomplete.

The stars are not yet ours.

Templates.Title: Campaign Complete
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} has concluded the {ArchetypeName} campaign.

{MissionsWon} victories from {TotalMissions} engagements. {EnemyFaction} is pushed back.

The stars remember those who fought here.

Templates.Title: Campaign Ended
Templates.Text:
Commander,

{PlayerFaction} could not hold the line. {MissionsWon} wins from {TotalMissions} was not enough to overcome {EnemyFaction}.

The campaign is over. The stars remain contested.
